/*********************************************
 * OPL 22.1.1.0 Model
 * Author: funno
 * Modified: Concise Logic, Integer Based, Fixed Reporting
 *********************************************/
using CPLEX;

// --- データ定義 ---
int RestNote = 0; 

int f_max = ...;
int s_max = ...;
range Frets = 0..f_max; // 0フレット(開放弦)対応
range Strings = 1..s_max;

{int} PlayableSounds = ...;

tuple combination {
    int corda;
    int fret;
}
{combination} AllCombinations = {<s,f> | s in Strings, f in Frets};

{int} OpenStrings[PlayableSounds] = ...;
{combination} Combinations[PlayableSounds] = ...;

string MidiNames[0..127] = ...;

int m = ...;
range Notes = 1..m;
range NotesButFirst = 2..m;
int note[Notes] = ...;
float availableTime[Notes] = ...;

range Fingers = 1..4;
range FingersButFirst = 2..4;
range HandPosition = 1..f_max;

// --- パラメータ群 ---
float scaleLength = ...;
float fretPosition[Frets];
float stringSpacing = ...;
float SP_max_mm[FingersButFirst] = ...;
float timePerMm = ...;
float fingerLengths_mm[Fingers] = ...;
float fingerDifficulty[Fingers] = ...;
float timeThresholdRatio = ...;
float highPositionPenalty = ...;
float natural_min_spread_mm[FingersButFirst] = ...;

// モデル内定数
float slide_pc_discount = 0.5;

// コスト係数
float d_PC = ...;
float d_SC = ...;
float d_HS = ...;
float d_DH = ...;
float d_NO = ...;

float alpha_PC = ...;
float alpha_SC = ...;
float alpha_HS = ...;
float alpha_DH = ...;
float alpha_NO = ...;

// フレット位置計算
execute {
    for (var f in Frets) {
        fretPosition[f] = scaleLength - (scaleLength / Math.pow(2, f / 12.0));
    }
}

// --- 変数定義 ---
dvar boolean o[Notes][Strings];
dvar boolean y[Notes][HandPosition][Fingers][AllCombinations];
dvar boolean x[Notes][HandPosition];

// --- 式の定義 ---

// PC: ポジション移動距離 (mm)
dexpr float PC[i in NotesButFirst] = 
    abs(sum(p in HandPosition) fretPosition[p] * x[i-1][p] - 
        sum(p in HandPosition) fretPosition[p] * x[i][p]);
        
dexpr float SlideSavings[i in NotesButFirst] = 
    sum(h in Fingers)
    sum(c1 in Combinations[note[i-1]])
    sum(c2 in Combinations[note[i]] : c1.corda == c2.corda)
    sum(p1 in HandPosition)
    sum(p2 in HandPosition)
        (abs(fretPosition[p1] - fretPosition[p2]) * y[i-1][p1][h][c1] * y[i][p2][h][c2]);
        
// 時間に応じたコスト削減係数
dexpr float timePenaltyFactor[i in NotesButFirst] = 
    minl(1.0, 50.0 / (availableTime[i-1] + 0.01)); 

// SC: 弦移動距離 (mm)
dexpr float SC[i in NotesButFirst] = 
    stringSpacing * abs(
        sum(p in HandPosition) sum(h in Fingers) sum(c in AllCombinations) c.corda * y[i-1][p][h][c] - 
        sum(p in HandPosition) sum(h in Fingers) sum(c in AllCombinations) c.corda * y[i][p][h][c] +
        sum(s in OpenStrings[note[i-1]]) s * o[i-1][s] -
        sum(s in OpenStrings[note[i]]) s * o[i][s]);

// HS: 手の広がり (mm)
dexpr float HS[i in Notes] = 
    (note[i] == RestNote) ? 0.0 : 
    sum(p in HandPosition) 
    sum(h in FingersButFirst) 
    sum(c in AllCombinations : c.fret >= p) 
        maxl(0, (fretPosition[c.fret] - fretPosition[p]) - natural_min_spread_mm[h]) * y[i][p][h][c];

// DH: 押弦難易度
dexpr float DH[i in Notes] = 
    (note[i] == RestNote) ? 0.0 : 
    sum(p in HandPosition) 
    sum(h in Fingers) 
    sum(c in Combinations[note[i]])
        (
         maxl(0, ((c.corda - 1) * stringSpacing) - fingerLengths_mm[h] * 0.8) * fingerDifficulty[h] 
         + maxl(0, c.fret - 12.0) * highPositionPenalty
        ) * y[i][p][h][c];


dexpr float tot_PC_Raw = sum(i in NotesButFirst) PC[i] * timePenaltyFactor[i];
dexpr float tot_SlideSavings = sum(i in NotesButFirst) SlideSavings[i] * timePenaltyFactor[i];

dexpr float tot_PC = tot_PC_Raw - (tot_SlideSavings * slide_pc_discount);
dexpr float tot_SC = sum(i in NotesButFirst) SC[i] * timePenaltyFactor[i];
dexpr float tot_HS = sum(i in Notes) HS[i];
dexpr float tot_DH = sum(i in Notes) DH[i];
dexpr float tot_NO = sum(i in Notes) sum(s in Strings : s in OpenStrings[note[i]]) o[i][s];


// --- MODEL ---
minimize
    alpha_PC * d_PC * tot_PC +
    alpha_SC * d_SC * tot_SC +
    alpha_HS * d_HS * tot_HS +
    alpha_DH * d_DH * tot_DH +
    alpha_NO * d_NO * tot_NO;

subject to {
    // 音を鳴らす
    forall(i in Notes)
        vinc2:
            sum(s in Strings : s in OpenStrings[note[i]]) o[i][s] +
            sum(p in HandPosition) sum(h in Fingers) sum(c in Combinations[note[i]]) y[i][p][h][c] 
            == (note[i] != RestNote);

    // 不正な変数の禁止
    forall(i in Notes)
        vinc2neg:
            sum(p in HandPosition) sum(h in Fingers) 
            sum(c in AllCombinations : c not in Combinations[note[i]]) y[i][p][h][c] == 0;

    // ハンドポジションの一意性
    forall(i in Notes)
        vinc3:
            sum(p in HandPosition) x[i][p] == 1;

    // 指とポジションの同期
    forall(i in Notes)
        forall(p in HandPosition)
            vinc4:
                sum(h in Fingers) sum(c in AllCombinations) y[i][p][h][c] <= x[i][p];

    // レガート時のポジション連続性
    forall(i in NotesButFirst)
        forall(p in HandPosition)
            vinc5:
                x[i][p] - x[i-1][p] <= 1 - sum(s in OpenStrings[note[i]]) o[i][s];
                
    forall(i in NotesButFirst) 
        vinc6:
            (PC[i] * timePerMm) <= availableTime[i-1];

    // 7. 手の広がり制限 (最大)
    forall(i in Notes)
        forall(p in HandPosition)
            forall(h in FingersButFirst)
                forall(c in AllCombinations : c.fret >= p)
                    vinc7:
                        (fretPosition[c.fret] - fretPosition[p]) * y[i][p][h][c] <= SP_max_mm[h];

    // 8. 手の広がり制限 (最小 / 順序逆転防止)
    forall(i in Notes)
        forall(p in HandPosition)
            forall(h in FingersButFirst)
                forall(c in AllCombinations) // フィルタなし
                    vinc8:
                        (natural_min_spread_mm[h] * y[i][p][h][c]) <= 
                        (fretPosition[c.fret] - fretPosition[p]) * y[i][p][h][c];
    // 人差指の基準
    forall(i in Notes)
        forall(p in HandPosition)
            forall(c in AllCombinations)
                vinc9:
                    (c.fret - p) * y[i][p][1][c] == 0;

    // 同一指の連続使用制限
    forall(i in NotesButFirst)
        forall(h in Fingers)
            forall(c in AllCombinations)
                vinc10c: 
                    sum(p in HandPosition) sum(c1 in AllCombinations : c1.fret != c.fret && c1.corda != c.corda) y[i][p][h][c1] 
                    <= 1 - sum(p in HandPosition) y[i-1][p][h][c];

    // 運指維持
    forall(i in NotesButFirst)
        forall(c in Combinations[note[i]] inter Combinations[note[i-1]])
            forall(h in Fingers)
                sum(p in HandPosition) y[i][p][h][c] +
                sum(p in HandPosition) sum(h2 in Fingers : h2 != h) y[i-1][p][h2][c] 
                <= 1;
}

// --- MAIN BLOCK ---
main {
    
    cplex.epgap = 0.03;
    cplex.mipemphasis = 4;
    
    
    thisOplModel.generate();
    if (cplex.solve()) {
        var obj = cplex.getObjValue();
        writeln(">>> 解が見つかりました。Objective: ", obj);
        
        var bestBound = cplex.getBestObjValue();
        var gap = 0.0;
        if (Math.abs(obj) > 0.000001) {
             gap = Math.abs(obj - bestBound) / (0.0000001 + Math.abs(obj));
        }
        writeln(">>> Gap (Approx): ", gap * 100, "%");
        thisOplModel.postProcess();
    } else {
        writeln(">>> 解が見つかりませんでした。");
    }
}

// --- EXECUTE BLOCK ---
execute {
    writeln("Note\tString\tFret\tHandposition\tFinger");
    for (var i in Notes) {
        
        if (note[i] == RestNote) {
            write("R", "\t");
        } else {
            write(MidiNames[note[i]], "\t");
        }

        // 1. 開放弦チェック
        var isOpenString = 0;
        for (var s in Strings) {
            if (o[i][s] == 1) {
                write(s, "\t0\t");
                isOpenString = 1;
            }
        }

        // 2. 押弦チェック (開放弦でない場合のみ)
        if (isOpenString == 0 && note[i] != RestNote) {
             for (var p in HandPosition) { 
                for (var h in Fingers) {
                    for (var c in AllCombinations) {
                        if (y[i][p][h][c] == 1) {
                            write(c.corda, "\t", c.fret, "\t");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 休符の場合のダミー
        if (note[i] == RestNote) {
             write("0\t0\t"); 
        }

        // 3. ハンドポジションと指
        var found = 0;
        if (note[i] != RestNote) {
            for (var p in HandPosition) {
                if (x[i][p] == 1) {
                    write(p, "\t");
                    
                    if (isOpenString == 1) {
                        write("0");
                        found = 1;
                    } else {
                        for (var h in Fingers) {
                            for (var c in AllCombinations) {
                                if (y[i][p][h][c] == 1) {
                                    write(h);
                                    found = 1;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            write("0\tx");
            found = 1;
        }

        if (found == 0) write("x");
        writeln();
    }

    writeln();
    writeln("\n--- Cost Breakdown ---");
    
    // 集計変数が定義されたので参照可能
    var costPC = alpha_PC * d_PC * tot_PC;
    var costSC = alpha_SC * d_SC * tot_SC;
    var costHS = alpha_HS * d_HS * tot_HS;
    var costDH = alpha_DH * d_DH * tot_DH;
    var costNO = alpha_NO * d_NO * tot_NO;
    
    writeln("  Position Change (PC): ", costPC);
    writeln("  String Change   (SC): ", costSC);
    writeln("  Hand Spread     (HS): ", costHS);
    writeln("  Difficulty Hold (DH): ", costDH);
    writeln("  Open String     (NO): ", costNO);
    writeln("-----------------------------------------");
    writeln("  Total Cost (Sum)    : ", costPC+costSC+costHS+costDH+costNO);
    writeln("-----------------------------------------");
}
